organisation: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
dataset: eSankhyiki portal (National Accounts Statistics, CPI, IIP, ASI modules)
summary: MoSPI's central data portal for national accounts (GDP, GVA by sector), CPI, IIP and Annual Survey of Industries, with state- and item-level breakdowns for roughly the last ten years. Each dataset has metadata and built-in visualisations.
frequency: Monthly to annual, depending on the product
formats: Unknown (Excel downloads mentioned in MoSPI releases)

organisation: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
dataset: Consumer Price Index (CPI) monthly press releases and annexures
summary: Monthly all-India and combined CPI headline inflation (general index, food, and other groups), with state and item-wise indices released as Excel annexures on the eSankhyiki portal. Recent releases are on the new base 2024=100 series.

ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
dataset: Index of Industrial Production (IIP) base 2022-23 microdata catalog
summary: All-India monthly index of industrial production volume (mining, manufacturing, electricity, water) with 1,042 items grouped into 463 item groups, base 2022-23 = 100, compiled from factory records.
formats: Unknown (Get Microdata option; DDI/XML and JSON metadata)

ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
dataset: Household Consumption Expenditure Survey (HCES) 2023-24 unit-level microdata
summary: Unit-level household consumption expenditure data from a national survey (fieldwork August 2023 to July 2024), covering 14,827 first-stage units across rural and urban India, with food, consumables, services and durables questionnaires.
formats: Unknown (Get Microdata; layout file, DDI/XML and JSON metadata)
note: Login needed for the Get Microdata option. Portal disclaimer: MoSPI accepts no liability for use of its contents.

ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
dataset: Sixth Economic Census (2013-14) microdata catalog
summary: Establishment-level data on enterprises and persons employed in all non-agricultural economic activity (national totals of about 58.5 million establishments and 131.3 million persons employed). The public dataset is an anonymised re-organised file (V1.0).
formats: Unknown (Get Microdata; DDI/XML and JSON metadata)

dataset: Database on Indian Economy (DBIE) / RBI data warehouse
summary: RBI's main time-series portal for macroeconomic and financial aggregates: output, prices, money, banking, public finance, forex and balance of payments. Also hosts the Handbook of Statistics and the Weekly Statistical Supplement.

dataset: Weekly Statistical Supplement (forex reserves and money-market tables)
summary: Weekly tables on India's total foreign exchange reserves (foreign currency assets, gold, SDRs, IMF reserve position) and other money, banking and financial indicators.

ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry (Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade)
dataset: Wholesale Price Index (WPI) portal - time series, item-level data and press releases
summary: Monthly all-India wholesale price index for commodities (primary articles, fuel and power, manufactured products), with item-level indices and time series back to April 1953. The site also hosts press-release archives and methodology documents.
frequency: Monthly (released on the 14th or the next working day)

dataset: CPI-IW all-India index (landing page with methodology and release links)
summary: Monthly consumer price index for industrial workers, computed as a weighted average of centre-level indices, covering the basket of goods and services consumed by industrial workers. Used for dearness allowance adjustments.
formats: Web page; monthly press notes and index letters in PDF

dataset: Compendium on Consumer Price Index for Industrial Workers (four volumes)
summary: Historical reference volumes describing the CPI-IW series, its methodology and its historical index values.

dataset: Economic Survey Statistical Appendix Volume II (landing page)
summary: Annual statistical tables accompanying the Economic Survey, covering national income and production, budgets, employment, monetary trends, prices, balance of payments, foreign trade and external assistance.

dataset: Statistical Appendix in English, Economic Survey 2024-25
summary: Full-length statistical appendix to the 2024-25 Economic Survey, with national income tables (Table 1 onward) and macro series on prices, balance of payments and public finance.

dataset: Monthly Accounts Review (Union Government receipts, expenditure, borrowings and deficit)
summary: Consolidated monthly Union Government accounts covering revenue and capital receipts, expenditure, borrowings and the fiscal and revenue deficit, compiled from ministry-level accounts. Past monthly reports are HTML tables by fiscal year.
frequency: Monthly (released after month end; March data is delayed to May)
formats: HTML tables (archive); no current files listed on this page

organisation: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
dataset: National Accounts Statistics dataviz index
summary: MoSPI's visualisation index for national accounts data, covering GDP and GVA growth and related national income aggregates.
frequency: Quarterly to annual (per the national accounts release calendar)

organisation: Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG)
dataset: CAG Audit Reports listing (Union Government, Finance, Taxes and Duties, Compliance and Performance audits)
summary: Searchable index of CAG audit reports covering Union Government ministries, departments and sectors, including finance, taxes and duties, with per-report PDFs. Reports cover audit findings on Finance Accounts, Appropriation Accounts and revenue programmes rather than raw statistics.

organisation: Department of Investment and Public Asset Management (DIPAM)
dataset: Disinvestment Receipts (year-wise, FY 2015-16 onward)
summary: Table for each financial year of central government share sales in CPSEs: company name, percentage of government stake sold, method (OFS, strategic sale, others), receipts in Rs crore, and post-sale government holding. The fetched copy showed the FY 2026-27 table.

organisation: Department of Investment and Public Asset Management (DIPAM)
dataset: Recent Disinvestments
summary: Current list of recent central government stake sales in CPSEs with the stake disinvested, method, receipts and government shareholding after sale.
note: Page shows only the most recent transactions; use the receipts page above for year-wise history.

ministry: Ministry of Finance, Department of Expenditure
dataset: DBT Bharat Reports - scheme-wise and state-wise DBT fund transfers
summary: Downloadable reports of Direct Benefit Transfer fund transfers by scheme, by state, and overall, along with lists of schemes reporting on the DBT Bharat portal and scheme-wise beneficiary counts. Scheme-wise fund transfer files are listed for years from 2013-14 to 2023-24.

ministry: Ministry of Finance, Department of Revenue
dataset: Direct tax statistics (collections time series and income-tax return statistics)
summary: Year-by-year direct tax collections (corporate tax, personal income tax), cost of collection and tax-to-GDP ratios, plus statistics of income-tax returns by income range for each assessment year.
note: The site refuses automated visitors; open it in a browser.

organisation: Ministry of Finance, Budget Division (Union Budget documents)
dataset: Union Budget Documents Archive (Expenditure Budget, Receipts Budget, Annual Financial Statement, Demands for Grants)
summary: Archive of Union Budget documents by year, including the Expenditure Budget volumes (ministry-wise allocations), Receipts Budget, Annual Financial Statement and Expenditure Profile statements such as food and fertiliser subsidy tables.

dataset: Finance Commission website - commission reports and studies (13th to 16th Commissions)
summary: Official site of the Finance Commission (constitutional body under Article 280) with reports, terms of reference, studies and background papers for the 13th, 14th, 15th and 16th Commissions. It is a document archive rather than a statistical dataset.

organisation: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)
dataset: Handbook on Indian Insurance Statistics
summary: Annual statistical handbook covering life, general, health and other insurance business, with premium, claims and insurer-level tables and international penetration and density comparisons. Editions are listed by financial year, going back to FY2007-08.
note: Recent editions (2021-22 onward) are ZIP archives only. Latest listed is 2024-25 (updated 03-02-2026). The landing page does not describe table contents.

organisation: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)
dataset: IRDAI Annual Reports
summary: The regulator's yearly report, including sector-wide premium volumes, market share by insurer group, policy counts and claim settlement commentary. Statistics sit inside PDF text and tables.
note: Latest listed is 2024-25 (dated 30-12-2025). English and Hindi versions are offered.

dataset: Payment System Indicators
summary: Monthly indicators on cards, prepaid instruments, ATM and point-of-sale activity, payment infrastructure counts and the fraud ratio for India's payment systems.
note: Listing shows monthly releases from October 2025 to September 2026, with archives for earlier years.

organisation: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
dataset: NPS and APY Statistical Data
summary: Downloadable NPS and Atal Pension Yojana datasets: annual series (A1-A23) on AUM, subscribers, APY enrolments and withdrawals; monthly series (M1-M8) on AUM, subscribers, contributions and state-wise data; and a daily NAV series (D1) by scheme and fund manager.
formats: XLSX (some files confirmed), other formats not stated
note: Annual series run to FY 2025-26 and monthly series start between 2009 and 2021. The daily NAV series is split at April 2023. Handbook and Pension Bulletin are listed only in site navigation.

organisation: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
dataset: Handbook of National Pension System Statistics (HoNPSS) 2024-25
summary: PFRDA's consolidated handbook of time-series statistics on NPS and APY across the subscriber journey, covering subscribers, contributions and AUM. The first edition was published in 2023.

dataset: EPFO Payroll Data
summary: Monthly provisional net payroll: new EPFO members by age band, computed from first-time Aadhaar-validated UAN joins less exits and rejoins. Search snippets show June 2025 as a record net addition of 21.89 lakh.

dataset: Standard Note on Employees' State Insurance Scheme (as on 01.01.2025)
summary: Reference note on the ESI scheme with counts of beneficiaries, insured persons, employees and contributions. Search snippets report 14.91 crore beneficiaries for FY 2024-25, with 384.36 lakh insured persons.

organisation: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
dataset: Handbook of Statistics on the Indian Securities Market 2025-26
summary: Annual handbook of securities-market statistics drawing on SEBI, RBI, exchanges, depositories and credit rating agencies. Covers market size, intermediaries, investors and mutual funds in around 150 tables; sources differ on the exact count.

organisation: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance (DFS)
dataset: PMJDY Progress Report (Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana)
summary: Progress report of beneficiary accounts, deposits and RuPay cards under PMJDY, broken down by bank type, rural and urban branches and women beneficiaries. Fetched figures: 59.71 crore beneficiaries and about Rs 3,28,002 crore deposits.
formats: PDF (state and bank reports linked separately)

organisation: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance (DFS)
dataset: Month-wise Progress Report, PMJDY (data.gov.in)
summary: Month-wise PMJDY progress datasets published on India's national open data portal.

organisation: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (DA&FW)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
dataset: PMFBY Administrative Statistics Dashboard
summary: Kharif-season dashboard of the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana from 2018, with premiums, sum insured, claims and farmer categories by year and state or district. Search snippets report claims peaking at about Rs 22.1 lakh crore in 2019.
formats: Unknown (CSV per a secondary catalogue listing)

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
dataset: PM-JAY Insights Dashboards
summary: Suite of PM-JAY dashboards covering state and district performance, procedure and hospital data, hospital empanelment, portability and village penetration, with hospital admissions, empanelments and beneficiaries. Search snippets give 9.53 crore admissions and 40.96 crore Ayushman cards as of 27 May 2025.

organisation: National Health Authority (NHA) via India Open Government Data Platform (data.gov.in)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
dataset: State/UT-wise Number of Authorised Hospital Admissions under AB PM-JAY
summary: State and UT-wise count of hospital admissions authorised under AB PM-JAY, covering 2019-20 to 2024-25 according to the search listing.

organisation: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI)
ministry: Independent regulator (statutory board under Ministry of Corporate Affairs)
dataset: IBBI Quarterly Newsletters (insolvency outcomes)
summary: Quarterly newsletters with corporate insolvency outcomes: CIRP and liquidation counts, resolution plans, creditor recovery and haircuts, and IPE numbers. Search results show the latest issue covers April-June 2026, with 3,074 CIRPs ended in liquidation.

organisation: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
dataset: NABARD Annual Reports and Annual Statistical Statements
summary: Financial reports from 1982-83 to 2024-25, plus annual statistical statements with Excel and PDF tables on state cooperative banks, regional rural banks and RIDF disbursements by state.

organisation: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)
dataset: MSME Pulse
summary: Quarterly report on MSME credit: outstanding balances, borrower segments by exposure size, new-to-credit share and early delinquency, combining commercial lending with business loans to individuals. The July 2026 edition reports Rs 65.8 lakh crore outstanding as of March 2026.
note: Some special editions use bureau data (TransUnion CIBIL). Requesting the report by email needs a form and OTP. Edition archive is on the same page.

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
dataset: National Family Health Survey (NFHS): reports, fact sheets and data
summary: Household survey on fertility, family planning, child nutrition and anaemia, maternal and child health and women's health. National, state and district fact sheets and reports for each survey round.

organisation: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
dataset: Health Management Information System (HMIS)
summary: Monthly reporting from public health facilities on service delivery: deliveries, births, immunisation, outpatient and inpatient counts, and facility infrastructure, with standard reports down to district level.

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
dataset: National Health Profile (annual publication)
summary: Annual compendium covering demography, socio-economic status, disease morbidity, health infrastructure and human resources for health, at national and state level.

organisation: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (ORGI)
dataset: Sample Registration System (SRS) Statistical Reports
summary: Annual national and state-level estimates of fertility (crude birth rate, total fertility rate), mortality (infant and under-five mortality rates) and related demographic indicators from a large sample survey.

organisation: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (ORGI)
dataset: Vital Statistics of India based on Civil Registration System (CRS) report
summary: Compiled counts of registered births and deaths from state and UT civil registrars, with sex ratio at birth and other vital statistics at national and state level.

organisation: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (ORGI)
dataset: Medical Certification of Cause of Death (MCCD) annual report
summary: Cause-of-death data from medically certified deaths across states and UTs, tabulated by cause, age and sex.

organisation: Central Tuberculosis Division, National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
dataset: India TB Report (annual reports index)
summary: Annual national and state-level TB report covering notifications, treatment outcomes, missing cases, and programme performance from the Ni-kshay patient management system.
note: Index page lists India TB Reports for 2011 to 2024 (plus RNTCP status reports 2001-2010). No 2025 or 2026 edition is listed on the page.

organisation: Ministry of Women and Child Development (MWCD)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
dataset: Poshan Tracker statistics dashboard
summary: Beneficiary coverage and child growth-monitoring indicators from the Anganwadi and Mission Poshan 2.0 monitoring system, shown by year and geography.

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
dataset: ABDM public dashboard (ABHA, health professionals and health facility registries)
summary: Counts of ABHA health IDs by state, gender and age, registered health professionals and health facilities, and partner-wise linkage activity under the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission.

organisation: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
dataset: CoWIN vaccination dashboard
summary: Aggregate COVID-19 vaccination session and dose data at national, state and district level, with site-level detail for some vaccination sites.
formats: Web dashboard, API (individual data requires beneficiary OTP)

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
dataset: e-RaktKosh blood bank stock and donation portal
summary: Blood stock by blood group and blood bank, with donor registration and donation camp records, reported by licensed blood centres across states and districts.

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
dataset: CDSCO alerts: monthly spurious drug and Not of Standard Quality (NSQ) lists
summary: Monthly lists of drug batches declared spurious and of drugs not of standard quality from central and state testing, with product name, manufacturer and batch details, plus recalls and device alerts.
note: Alerts page lists downloadable PDFs dated 2010 to 2026. Product-level lists are in PDFs, not a structured dataset.

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
dataset: Longitudinal Ageing Study in India (LASI) datasets
summary: Panel survey of older adults aged 45 and above covering health, disability, economic status and social wellbeing, with biomarker (DBS) and spirometry files for Wave 1.
formats: Restricted data files via data catalogue

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
dataset: National Health Accounts estimates for India
summary: National estimates of total health expenditure by source of funds, provider and function, including the out-of-pocket share, for each financial year.

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Department of Health Research)
dataset: National Cancer Registry Programme (NCRP) report
summary: Cancer incidence counts and rates from population-based cancer registries, reported by registry and cancer site, with hospital-based registry tabulations in linked reports.

ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
dataset: NHM MIS monthly national overview and state ES reports
summary: Monthly national overview of NHM programme indicators, with state-wise tables for health service delivery and outcomes.

organisation: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (ORGI)
dataset: Census of India 2011 Primary Census Abstract (PCA) tables
summary: Census 2011 primary abstract tables at national, state, district and block level covering household counts, population by sex, age, caste and literacy, and work status; this entry covers houseless household tables.
note: This catalogue entry is for houseless-population tables; other PCA tables are listed in the same NADA catalogue (for example PCA OTH and PCA REL).

dataset: Crime in India (annual report, all editions)
summary: Police-recorded crime for every state, UT and metropolitan city: cases registered under the penal code and special laws, crimes against women, children and Scheduled Castes and Tribes, and police and court disposal of cases.

dataset: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India (annual report, all editions)
summary: Deaths from road and rail accidents, natural causes and other accidents, and suicides by cause, profession, age and sex, for every state, UT and large city.

dataset: Prison Statistics India (annual report, all editions)
summary: Prison capacity and occupancy, convicts, undertrials and detenues by sex, age, education and offence, deaths in prison, staff strength and prison budgets, for every state and UT.

ministry: Ministry of Law and Justice (eCourts Mission)
dataset: National Judicial Data Grid: District and Subordinate Courts dashboard
summary: Live dashboard of pending, instituted and disposed cases in district and subordinate courts, broken down by civil and criminal type and by case age. Can be filtered by state, district and court complex.
note: Dashboard figures change continuously and are not an archive. Some views use session tokens in the URL.

ministry: Ministry of Law and Justice (eCourts Mission)
dataset: National Judicial Data Grid: High Courts dashboard
summary: Dashboard of pending and disposed cases in the High Courts of India, with age-wise pendency and filters by High Court bench and case type.

organisation: Supreme Court of India (NJDG Supreme Court module)
dataset: National Judicial Data Grid: Supreme Court dashboard
summary: Dashboard of instituted, disposed and pending cases at the Supreme Court of India, including current-year institutions and disposals.

organisation: Supreme Court of India (Virtual Justice Clock)
dataset: Supreme Court agewise pendency and cases listed today
summary: Live table of pending Supreme Court cases by age bracket (0-1 years up to 30+ years) and the number listed for hearing on the day. Gives a current snapshot, not a historical series.
note: Snapshot only; no history. Figures are as on the day of viewing.

organisation: Bureau of Police Research and Development (BPR&D)
dataset: Data on Police Organisations (DoPO) publication page
summary: Annual compilation of police personnel, sanctioned and actual strength, vacancies, infrastructure, vehicles and police stations for states, UTs, central police organisations and CAPFs.

organisation: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
dataset: Road Accidents in India: report page
summary: Index of the annual Road Accidents in India report, with accident, death and injury counts from police data by state, UT, road type, vehicle type and victim age.

organisation: Department of Justice, Ministry of Law and Justice
dataset: Vacancies of judges in High Courts dashboard
summary: Dashboard of sanctioned, filled and vacant judge posts in the High Courts of India, with pending proposals for appointment at each stage.

dataset: Legal Service Beneficiaries Report
summary: Year-wise PDF reports on the number of persons who received free legal services through legal aid, counted by category of beneficiary. Covers April 2016 to March 2026.

dataset: Legal Service Clinics Report
summary: Year-wise reports on legal aid clinics set up across districts and taluks, covering the number of clinics and their activity. Covers April 2017 to March 2025.

dataset: NALSA Annual Reports
summary: Index of NALSA annual reports from 2018 onwards, plus a report on State Legal Services Authorities for 2021-22. Covers legal aid activity, Lok Adalats and policy developments.

dataset: Legal Aid Defence Counsel System (LADCS) dashboard
summary: Interactive dashboard of cases assigned to and disposed by legal aid defence counsel, bail statistics, and staffing figures under the Legal Aid Defence Counsel System.

dataset: NALSA Statistical Snapshot
summary: Summary snapshots of legal aid and legal services statistics for 2020, 2021 and 2022.

dataset: NHRC Annual Report 2023-24 (PDF)
summary: Annual report with complaint and case statistics, including cases of judicial and police custodial deaths, disposed by year and by state. Counts include some cases from earlier years.

dataset: Lokpal complaints statistics
summary: Year-wise statistics on complaints received by Lokpal, with a section on review and reconsideration of complaints. Covers recent financial years.

dataset: NCB Year End Press Release 2025 (PDF)
summary: Year-end summary of NCB drug seizures by quantity and value and of drug destruction in the year. National-level totals only, not broken down by state in this release.

dataset: Export Import Data Bank (TRADESTAT)
summary: India's merchandise export and import figures by commodity, country, region and port, in rupee and dollar terms. The annual databank covers financial years from 1997-98 and the monthly databank from January 2007, sourced from DGCI&S.

dataset: Trade Statistics (Monthly)
summary: Ministry-published monthly merchandise trade statistics for India, linked to the TRADESTAT databank.

dataset: Trade Statistics (Annual)
summary: Ministry-published annual merchandise trade statistics for India, linked to the TRADESTAT databank.

ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
dataset: Monthly Consumption of Petroleum Products (Open Government Data listing)
summary: Monthly consumption of LPG, naphtha, motor spirit, ATF, SKO, HSD, LDO, lubricants, fuel oil, bitumen, petroleum coke and other products, as listed on the Open Government Data platform. Some values may be provisional.

dataset: JPC Indian steel databank - production and performance statistics
summary: Official databank on the Indian iron and steel industry, publishing monthly production and consumption statistics for the sector. The Ministry's annual reports credit JPC as the source of crude steel production figures.

organisation: Startup India, Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
dataset: Startup India recognised startups count and listing
summary: Count and searchable listing of entities recognised as startups by DPIIT under the Startup India initiative. Press figures cite 1,97,692 recognised entities as of 31 October 2025.

organisation: Startup India, Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
dataset: TEJAS dashboard (Startup India)
summary: Dashboard counters for the TEJAS initiative, including the number of DPIIT-recognised startups and districts covered.

organisation: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
dataset: District-wise manufacturing MSMEs registered under Udyam (AIKosh dataset)
summary: District-level counts of manufacturing micro, small and medium enterprises registered on the Udyam portal, covering all India. Hosted on AIKosh, not on the Ministry's own site.

organisation: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
dataset: District-wise services MSMEs registered under Udyam till last date (AIKosh dataset)
summary: District-level counts of services-sector micro, small and medium enterprises registered on the Udyam portal across India.

organisation: Directorate General of Commercial Intelligence and Statistics (DGCI&S)
dataset: Report on goods movement estimated from GSTN e-way bill data, 2022-23
summary: One-off report that uses GSTN e-way bill data to estimate goods movement within India for FY 2022-23. It is an analytical report, not a live e-way bill series.

organisation: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM)
dataset: IP India Annual Report 2022-23
summary: Annual statistics on patent applications filed, examined, granted and disposed, with trademark and design filing figures for the financial year. Search snippets cite 82,811 patent applications filed in 2022-23.

dataset: Tourism statistics dashboard (data.tourism.gov.in)
summary: Interactive dashboard of foreign tourist arrivals and related tourism indicators. Search snippets show a 2025 figure of 9.15 million foreign tourist arrivals.

ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
dataset: Annual Survey of Industries (ASI) 2024-25 microdata
summary: Unit-level microdata from the Annual Survey of Industries for 2024-25, covering registered factories under the Factories Act, with DDI metadata and a data dictionary. Other ASI years are catalogued in the same library.
note: Access is via the 'Get Microdata' page and a Login option, so some downloads may need registration. Years and access terms vary per catalogue entry.

organisation: Ministry of Textiles, Office of the Development Commissioner for Handlooms
dataset: Fourth All India Handloom Census 2019-20 - state-wise annexure (Parliament reply, Dec 2025)
summary: State-wise counts of handloom weavers, allied workers and households from the Fourth All India Handloom Census 2019-20, as a PIB annexure. The census was conducted in 1987-88, 1995-96, 2009-10 and 2019-20.

organisation: Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
dataset: National Consumer Helpline grievance statistics (PIB release, Oct 2025)
summary: Official aggregate figures on National Consumer Helpline grievances, including call volumes, channel shares and refunds recovered. This is a press document, not a downloadable raw dataset.

dataset: MCA Master Data (company and LLP lookup on the MCA portal)
summary: Company and LLP master data (name, CIN or LLPIN, status, registered office, paid-up capital, incorporation date), viewable one record at a time. No official bulk download or API was found.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
dataset: Agmarknet: daily mandi prices and arrivals
summary: Daily mandi-level wholesale prices (minimum, maximum and modal) and arrival volumes for hundreds of commodities and thousands of varieties across wholesale markets. Browsable by state, market and commodity.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
dataset: e-NAM stakeholder data and live price dashboard
summary: Dashboard of e-NAM trading activity, including commodity-wise trade volumes, mandi-level price trends, stakeholder registrations and inter-state trade, as described in a 2026 government document.

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
dataset: Agricultural Statistics at a Glance 2021 (English)
summary: National and state-wise statistics on area, production and yield of principal crops, plus land use, irrigation, inputs and prices. Normal estimates are averaged over five-year periods.

organisation: Department of Consumer Affairs, Price Monitoring Division
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
dataset: Price Monitoring System: daily retail and wholesale prices of essential commodities
summary: Daily retail and wholesale prices of essential food items such as rice, wheat, pulses, edible oils, vegetables, sugar and milk, reported from price centres across the country, with all-India averages.

dataset: Weekly reservoir storage bulletin
summary: Weekly live storage, capacity and comparison with last year and normal storage for major reservoirs, with all-India, region-wise, state-wise and basin-wise tables. The bulletin in 2026 covered about 166 reservoirs.

organisation: Central Water Commission (CWC) and National Water Informatics Centre (NWIC)
dataset: India-WRIS: Water Resources Information System
summary: National water data: rainfall, river water levels and discharge, reservoir storage, groundwater levels and water quality, shown on maps and dashboards by basin, state and district.

ministry: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
dataset: India State of Forest Report 2023
summary: Assessment of forest and tree cover by state and district from satellite imagery with field checks, published every two years, with carbon stock and forest fire data.

organisation: Ministry of Rural Development, PMGSY Programme Implementation Unit (PMGSY-PIU)
dataset: Online Management, Monitoring and Accounting System (OMMAS) for PMGSY
summary: Habitation-level and road-project data for PMGSY, covering planning, tendering, execution, quality monitoring and receipts, with Citizen's Corner to see whether a habitation is included and construction status.

organisation: Ministry of Rural Development, Rural Housing Division
dataset: PMAY-G AwaasPlus 2024 reports index
summary: Index of state and national reports on sanctions, completions and financial progress under PMAY-G, generated from the AwaasSoft management information system.

organisation: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation (DDWS)
dataset: State/UT-wise number of ODF Plus villages under Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen), via data.gov.in
summary: Number of villages declared ODF Plus by state and UT, from the integrated management information system (IMIS) of SBM-G, with a national total of 563,242 as of 7 February 2025 in a search summary.

dataset: High-resolution daily gridded rainfall (0.25 x 0.25 degree), 1901 onwards
summary: Daily gridded rainfall in millimetres across India on a 0.25 by 0.25 degree grid (135 x 129 cells) for 1901 to 2024, one record per day per year.

dataset: Rainfall statistics: district, state and subdivision weekly and cumulative departures
summary: Rainfall departure and category statistics at district, state and subdivision level, including weekly cumulative departures and daily and cumulative distributions. Also has a national district-wise cumulative departure PDF.
note: Linked pages are the main presentation. The cumulative departure PDF is a page-image report.

organisation: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Agriculture Census Division
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
dataset: Agriculture Census
summary: Nationally aggregated characteristics of operational holdings, including number and area of holdings by size class, social group and gender of operators. Data is from Phase I and Phase II of the census.

organisation: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
ministry: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
dataset: PARIVESH single-window portal for environment, forest and wildlife clearances
summary: Single-window portal recording environment, forest and wildlife clearance proposals, their status, and related documents. Public viewing of some clearance details has been reported as limited.

organisation: Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation (DDWS)
dataset: Jal Jeevan Mission national dashboard (Status of tap water supply in rural homes)
summary: National dashboard of rural households with tap water connections, daily new connections, Har Ghar Jal certification status by state, district, block, panchayat and village, state-wise financial releases, and 100 per cent tap-connected villages.
note: State and district dashboards run separately (for example jjm.up.gov.in). Water quality results from WQMIS are also shown on the national dashboard.

ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
dataset: Snapshot of India's Oil & Gas Data (monthly ready reckoner) and related PPAC statistics
summary: A monthly compilation of crude oil, refining, petroleum product consumption, natural gas, LPG and tax data for the latest month plus historical time series. The homepage lists the September 2026 edition and related reports such as the India's Oil & Gas Ready Reckoner and the Natural Gas Monthly Report.

ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
dataset: Aadhaar Enrolment Dashboard
summary: Monthly Aadhaar enrolment volumes across all sectors for FY 2025-26, with a trend chart that shows state-wise figures on hover. It also gives counts of registrars, enrolment agencies and enrolment stations.

dataset: Telecom Subscription Data (monthly press releases)
summary: Monthly counts of wireline, wireless, broadband and total telephone subscribers for India, with operator-level figures in the press releases. The listing runs from April 2024 to September 2026.

dataset: National Power Portal: published reports
summary: Daily, monthly and annual power-sector reports from the Central Electricity Authority: generation by station and fuel, installed capacity, coal stock at power plants, and transmission and distribution figures.

organisation: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
dataset: Programme/Scheme wise Cumulative Physical Progress (renewable energy)
summary: Cumulative installed capacity of renewable energy by source and scheme, plus monthly additions. Search snippets refer to the edition as of 31 August 2026.

organisation: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
dataset: Renewable Energy Statistics (annual publication)
summary: Annual compendium of installed capacity and generation for renewable and non-renewable sources, with metadata that covers the period from FY 2014-15 onward.

organisation: Grid Controller of India Limited (Grid-India, formerly POSOCO)
dataset: Daily Power Supply Position (PSP) reports
summary: Daily all-India power supply position, covering demand met, shortages and generation for the date. It is issued under the Indian Electricity Grid Code.

dataset: Monthly Coal Statistics (provisional)
summary: Monthly raw coal and lignite production by company and subsidiary, with growth rates against the same month of the previous year. Monthly and cumulative figures are included.

organisation: Ministry of Coal (CIL and subsidiaries, SCCL, NLCIL, captive mines)
dataset: Monthly coal/lignite production and dispatch by company
summary: Monthly coal and lignite production and dispatch figures for Coal India, its subsidiaries, SCCL, NLC India and captive mines.
formats: Unknown (data.gov.in usually offers CSV, JSON and XML)

organisation: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
ministry: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
dataset: Cargo handled at Major Ports (monthly report)
summary: Monthly cargo volume handled at India's major ports, port by port and by commodity, with year-on-year comparisons. Search snippets indicate that the underlying figures come from the Indian Ports Association.

organisation: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
dataset: Energy Statistics India (annual publication)
summary: Annual compendium of energy supply, demand and balances across coal, petroleum, natural gas, electricity and renewables, with energy balance tables and sustainable energy indicators. Compiled from the Ministries of Coal, Petroleum, Power and New and Renewable Energy.

ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
dataset: Infrastructure project monitoring (OCMS / PAIMANA) and Performance Monitoring Dashboard
summary: Monitors central-sector infrastructure projects costing Rs 150 crore or more, now run through the PAIMANA platform, which replaced OCMS-2006. A performance dashboard tracks indicators across sub-sectors, including power and civil aviation.

organisation: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
dataset: Integrated Mission Dashboard (PMAY-U, AMRUT, Smart Cities)
summary: Consolidated dashboard of physical and financial progress across MoHUA's major urban schemes, including PMAY-U, AMRUT and Smart Cities.

organisation: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban (PMAY-U) programme, MoHUA
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
dataset: PMAY-Urban progress figures
summary: Progress of the national urban housing scheme: houses sanctioned, grounded and completed, and central assistance released, with state-wise progress reports.

dataset: Year-wise Telecom Subscribers 2008 to 2022 (data.gov.in)
summary: Annual telecom subscriber counts split into wireline and wireless, public and private operators, and rural and urban. Series stops at 2022.
formats: Unknown (data.gov.in usually offers CSV, JSON and XML)

organisation: Department of School Education and Literacy (DoSEL)
dataset: UDISE+ public dashboard (school education data)
summary: Aggregated school education indicators from the Unified District Information System for Education Plus, such as enrolment and Gross Enrolment Ratio, shown at national and state level with district drill-downs according to third-party guides. School-level analytics and detailed reports need a login.

dataset: NIRF ranking publications (overall, category-wise)
summary: Annual rankings of higher education institutions by category (overall, engineering, management and others), with total scores and ranks. Results are published as ranking PDFs by year and category.

dataset: Quarterly Employment Survey (QES) round reports under AQEES
summary: Quarterly employment figures for establishments with 10 or more workers across nine selected sectors, covering organised and unorganised segments. The page lists six round reports, from the first (2021) to the sixth.

dataset: e-Shram registrations of unorganised workers (ministry press release)
summary: Ministry statistics on total e-Shram registrations of unorganised workers, which an August 2026 release put at about 31.89 crore, with state-wise breakdowns in some releases. The live dashboard is said to be at eshram.gov.in/dashboard.

dataset: NSAP beneficiary abstract (National Social Assistance Programme)
summary: State and UT-wise counts of beneficiaries under the National Social Assistance Programme pensions (old age, widow, disability and others), with yearly state-wise series listed on the open data portal.

dataset: NSP public dashboard on scholarship application processing
summary: A dashboard visualising how scholarship applications are received and processed across schemes onboarded to the NSP, with a link to applications processed in previous academic years.

organisation: National Institution for Transforming India (NITI Aayog)
dataset: SDG India Index and Dashboard
summary: Scores and ranks for every state and UT on the Sustainable Development Goals, with the underlying indicator values for each goal.

organisation: National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)
dataset: PARAKH Rashtriya Sarvekshan (PRS) 2024 reports and dashboards
summary: Learning-outcome assessment of students in Classes 3, 6 and 9 (survey held 4 December 2024), with national, state and district reports and dashboards for NAS, SEAS and other studies. It replaced the National Achievement Survey (NAS).
note: The page lists dashboards and no data downloads. No raw microdata download was found. Earlier NAS report cards are kept as legacy resources.

dataset: National Career Service (NCS) statistics and Occupational Shortage Index dashboard
summary: Programme information for the NCS, including 997 employment exchanges and 52 career sectors, plus a Power BI dashboard on the Occupational Shortage Index and labour market trends. Live vacancy and job-seeker counts sit on the separate portal ncs.gov.in.

ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
dataset: PLFS Calendar Year 2025 annual unit-level microdata
summary: Unit-level Periodic Labour Force Survey data for January to December 2025, covering labour force participation rate, worker population ratio and unemployment rate in usual status and current weekly status, for rural and urban areas.

ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
dataset: PLFS monthly unit-level microdata (April to December 2025)
summary: Monthly unit-level Periodic Labour Force Survey data for April to December 2025, covering employment, unemployment and labour force status of individuals.

ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
dataset: PLFS quarterly unit-level microdata (April-June 2025 to October-December 2025)
summary: Quarterly unit-level Periodic Labour Force Survey data covering labour force and employment indicators for each rolling quarter from April-June 2025 onward.

ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
dataset: PLFS Key Employment and Unemployment Indicators, Calendar Year 2024
summary: Key Employment and Unemployment Indicators from the Periodic Labour Force Survey for January to December 2024, covering labour force participation, worker population ratio and unemployment rates.

ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
dataset: Year-wise total grievances received and redressed on CPGRAMS (2020-2024)
summary: Annual national totals of public grievances received and redressed through the CPGRAMS system for 2020 to 2024. Aggregate counts only, not case-level records.

dataset: Local Government Directory (LGD) - States
summary: Official codes and names for Indian states and union territories from the Local Government Directory, used to link administrative units across datasets. Related resources on data.gov.in cover sub-districts, local bodies and villages.

ministry: NITI Aayog (Government of India think tank, reports to the Prime Minister's Office)
dataset: National Data and Analytics Platform (NDAP)
summary: Portal that hosts government datasets from central and state bodies in a standardised schema, with analytics, visualisation and download tools for cross-sector analysis. Launched publicly in May 2022.

organisation: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
dataset: MoSPI Microdata Portal (unit-level survey data catalogue)
summary: Catalogue of unit-level data from national surveys and censuses: household and individual records from NSS rounds, PLFS, consumption surveys, the Annual Survey of Industries and the Economic Census, with documentation.

organisation: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)
dataset: Statistical Year Book India (download tables and data page)
summary: MoSPI's annual compendium of national statistics across economy, population, prices, agriculture, industry and social sectors. The MoSPI FAQ points to this download page for the current edition and aggregated data such as CPI and ASI.

dataset: ECI Atlas 2024 (e-book, Lok Sabha 2024 voter and constituency statistics)
summary: Statistical e-book with national and constituency-level tables on electors and turnout, including voter growth since 1951-52 and constituency-wise figures for the 2024 Lok Sabha election. Page 89 covers total voters by constituency.

dataset: Lok Sabha Questions and Answers (Digital Sansad)
summary: Searchable archive of starred and unstarred Lok Sabha questions and ministry answers, filterable by Lok Sabha, session, date, member, ministry and subject. Records cover the question hour from the 1st Lok Sabha onward.
formats: Web search results; answers as PDF annexes (not confirmed)

organisation: Rajya Sabha Secretariat (Official Debates archive, rsdebate.nic.in, now on sansad.in)
dataset: Rajya Sabha Official Debates and Questions archive
summary: Verbatim record of Rajya Sabha debates and question-and-answer sessions from the first session in 1952, browsable by session, title, member, date and subject. Newer debates are on eparlib.sansad.in and sansad.in.

organisation: Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG)
ministry: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
dataset: CPGRAMS Grievance Dashboard (pgportal.gov.in)
summary: Live dashboard of public grievances filed on CPGRAMS, with received, disposed and pending counts by ministry and state/UT for a selected period. The fetched view covered 1 January to 16 November 2026.

organisation: Department of Pension and Pensioners Welfare (CPENGRAMS)
ministry: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
dataset: CPENGRAMS Pension Grievance Dashboard
summary: Dashboard of pension grievances received through online, call centre, postal and email channels, with pending ageing buckets and the share resolved within timeline. The fetched view covered grievances from 1 January 2026.

dataset: LGD Directory Download (states, districts, sub-districts, villages, development blocks)
summary: Official directory of all states, districts, sub-districts, villages and local bodies with LGD codes, downloadable for all states or a single state's development blocks and for modifications in a date range.

organisation: E-Panchayat Mission Mode Project, Ministry of Panchayati Raj (eGramSwaraj)
dataset: eGramSwaraj Dashboard and Reports (Panchayat profile, planning, accounts, sponsored schemes data)
summary: Dashboards and reports on gram, block and zilla panchayats, covering panchayat profiles, plans, accounts (expenditure reports), audits and sponsored scheme data, with state, district, block and gram panchayat drill-downs.

organisation: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice (India Code)
dataset: India Code - Central Acts and subordinate legislation
summary: Official repository of central and state Acts, with search by short title, act number, year, ministry and full-text phrase. Central Acts are covered from 1836 onward according to a search snippet.

dataset: Abhilekh Patal - online archival records portal
summary: Online access point to National Archives of India holdings, with a reference index of about 7 million records (metadata for about 3 million) and digitised scans of about 300,000 records. Unrecorded items can be requested through the Digitize on Demand service.

dataset: PIB Press Release Archive (1947 onward)
summary: Archive of official Government of India press releases, split into 1947-2001 (scanned paper releases), 2002-2003 (HTML) and 2004 onward (searchable by ministry, year and keyword). It also holds PM releases, photos and cabinet decisions.

ministry: NITI Aayog (reports to the Prime Minister's Office)
dataset: Output-Outcome Monitoring Framework (OOMF) dashboard
summary: Monitoring dashboard tracking more than 5,000 output and outcome indicators across over 500 central sector and centrally sponsored schemes, drawn from ministry data. It is the successor to the older NITI Aayog scheme monitoring work.

dataset: Survey of India Online Maps Portal (topographic and digital map products)
summary: Portal for downloading national topographic and digital map products, including the free Open Series 1:50,000 and 1:250,000 map sheets and paid digital products. Order and download flow works through a registered account.

organisation: Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India (RGI)
dataset: Census tables
summary: Census of India tables: Primary Census Abstract, household, language, religion, migration and worker tables, mostly from the 1991, 2001 and 2011 censuses, down to district and village level.

organisation: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
dataset: VAHAN dashboard: vehicle registrations
summary: Vehicle registrations from transport offices across the country, by state, registering office, vehicle class, fuel type and manufacturer. Widely used as a count of vehicle sales.

organisation: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
dataset: Udyam registration dashboard (district-wise)
summary: Number of micro, small and medium enterprises registered on the Udyam portal, by state and district.

ministry: Ministry of Finance, Department of Revenue
dataset: GST statistics
summary: Monthly GST collections by state and tax head, numbers of registered taxpayers and return-filing figures.

organisation: Goods and Services Tax Council (GST Council)
dataset: GST revenue
summary: Gross GST revenue collected each month, split into central, state, integrated GST and cess.

dataset: All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE)
summary: Annual survey of universities and colleges: number of institutions, student enrolment by level, sex and social group, teachers, and gross enrolment ratio, by state.

ministry: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
dataset: Central Control Room for Air Quality Management
summary: Live and historical readings from continuous air quality monitoring stations across Indian cities: PM2.5, PM10, nitrogen dioxide, sulphur dioxide, ozone and the Air Quality Index.

organisation: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (DA&FW)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
dataset: UPAg: Unified Portal for Agricultural Statistics
summary: Crop area, production and yield estimates, mandi prices, procurement, stocks and trade for major crops, brought together from several government sources.

organisation: Department of Food and Public Distribution (DFPD)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
dataset: National Food Security Act (NFSA) portal
summary: Ration cards and beneficiaries covered under the food security law, foodgrain allocation and offtake, and fair price shops, by state.

dataset: Bhuvan: Indian geoportal
summary: Satellite imagery and map layers for India, including land use and land cover, water bodies, and disaster and thematic maps, with some data open for download.

organisation: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MoPNG)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
dataset: Indian Petroleum and Natural Gas Statistics
summary: Annual statistics on crude oil and natural gas production, refining, consumption of petroleum products, imports and exports, prices, and taxes.

dataset: AAI Traffic News
summary: Monthly passengers, aircraft movements and freight handled at every Indian airport, split into domestic and international.

ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
dataset: eTaal: electronic transaction counts
summary: Counts of electronic transactions delivered by central and state government services, by ministry, state and service.

ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
dataset: Open Government Data Platform India (data.gov.in)
summary: The central catalogue of datasets released by ministries and states, searchable by sector and ministry, with downloads and programming interfaces (APIs).

ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
dataset: e-Gazette of India
summary: Every notification published in the Gazette of India: Acts, rules, orders and appointments, searchable by ministry, date and gazette part.
